item.description: During the Christmas and New Year’s celebrations, Sinaloa Civil Protection responded to a total of 19 incidents in various municipalities throughout the state, most of them related to traffic accidents and vehicles running off the road, reported the agency’s director, Roy Navarrete Cuevas. item.description: The influx of tourists to the community of Isla de la Piedra, located across the waterway from Mazatlán, has been steady during the December holidays thanks to the warm weather experienced around midday. item.title: Mazatlán tourism rebounds: 14.4% more hotel occupancy and 253,000 cruise ship passengers in 2025
